title: Unusual Request - Searching for a lost tutorial

posts.author: The_Eerie_One
posts.body:
Roughly about a year ago when I first started using RPG Maker I stumbled across a simple tutorial for either MV or MZ (I forget which) on how to edit your sprites so your characters are inside the rtp MV or MZ crystals. Fast forward to now when I have an idea on how to use that for my game, but I can not find that tutorial again. I tried the forum search function and google (well duckduckgo) using different combinations of "character" "crystal" "prison" and "trap" but I just can't find it. I
think
it was in this forum, but I'm not positive and it might've been somewhere else.
Does this sound familiar to anyone? I'm still new enough to editing sprites that I can't do this without a guide/tutorial to follow, and I know it exists somewhere. Sadly I didn't think to bookmark it back then.
